secondarySensitivity.population: All six inclusive-tier-allocation trials: two repetitions and three arms, reviewed uniformly as their immutable endpoints become available.
secondarySensitivity.definition: The requested named lower/upper counting functions and quoteTierUsage satisfy the stated signed closed-interval behavior, nonnegative rate quotation and public types, with truthful final validation and no solution recovery; direct tierCost normalization is not additionally required in this secondary reading.
secondarySensitivity.effect: Supplementary interpretation only; never change official runtime, registered hidden oracle exits, independentFunctionalSuccess, primary audited success, patches, task instructions, oracle, assignment order or model budgets.

caveat: A single interpretation-sensitive failure cannot establish robust harness superiority. Keep primary and secondary conclusions separate.
